citations.assessment: Chullin explicitly gives Oshaya’s patronymic and testimony before Akiva in Tarfon’s name about the flayed animal. The reciprocal preserves a different name in its separate Tosefta note.
The Chullin testimony and reciprocal Oshaya notice agree. Both Tosefta parallels transmit a similar teaching from Tarfon with a differently named perfumer; no identity equation is admitted.

evidence.witness: The Tosefta according to to codex Vienna. Third Augmented Edition, JTS 2001

holds.reason: The differently named perfumer of the Tosefta parallels requires distinct treatment.
